overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met to consider several development applications, approving a use variance and special permit for a maker space at 400 Riverside Avenue, granting dimensional variances while continuing a parking permit for 106 Alexander Avenue, and accepting a withdrawal for 41 Yale Street.

items.title: 41 Yale Street
items.summary: The board voted to allow the applicant to withdraw the petition without prejudice after the property was redesigned to eliminate the need for zoning relief.

items.title: 106 Alexander Avenue
items.summary: The board approved variances for lot area and lot width to replace a single-family home with a two-family dwelling, but denied a special permit for non-conforming tandem parking. The applicant requested to continue the matter to January 8 to submit revised parking plans, which the board approved.

items.title: 400 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: The board approved a use variance to operate a flexible co-working and maker space and granted a special permit to utilize a portion of the vacant industrial property for warehouse and wholesale use.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Administrative Business
items.summary: The board voted to approve the meeting minutes from the previous meeting and discussed upcoming updates to the board's administrative regulations.
